name: Pull Request

about: Open a PR for The Quote Garden.

---

## What changed

One or two sentences.

## Why

Link the issue, design doc, or plan this implements (e.g. `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-07-...`).

## How to test

What the reviewer should run / tap to verify.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated where the change warrants it
- [ ] `./gradlew :app:test` passes locally
- [ ] Docs / specs updated if behavior changed
- [ ] No secrets committed (`local.properties`, keystore, credentials)
